title: Pork fillet with apple and sage
summary: Pork fillet cooked quickly with apple, sage and cabbage, plus a few new potatoes. A British autumn plate that doesn't rely on a creamy sauce.

steps.instruction: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, then drain. Season the pork with salt and pepper.
Heat half the oil and brown the pork for about 2 minutes a side until just cooked through. Lift it out and rest it.
steps.tip: Fillet is lean. If the juices run clear, stop. Another minute and it dries.

steps.instruction: Add the remaining oil, onion, apple and sage. Fry until the apple takes a little colour, then add the cabbage, mustard and water. Cover and cook until the cabbage softens.
Return the pork and any juices, warm through for a minute and serve with the potatoes.
